source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; later OOB history establishes standard App 0x06/0x4D read semantics.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step requests configuration verification and log clearing.

historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart identifies standard App 0x06/0x4D bounded read.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats scope/schema/reference as Project inputs; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Read and decode one approved user's payload authorization for a selected channel without activating or changing any payload.
original_method: Use protected standard App 0x06/0x4D with validated user/channel selector, response schema and least-privilege policy reference.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies the bounded identity/channel and policy reference; no point-of-action confirmation is needed for the read.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative once standard 0x4D history is considered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw App 0x06/0x4D or equivalent read-only API with pinned parser.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read one approved tuple, validate completion/length/all access fields and reserved bits, compare the policy reference and prove no session/payload state changed.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a bounded standard read in Review guidance without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only selected user/channel and returned payload map covered.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect masks can misreport effective management privilege.

project_override_considerations: Alternate readers need equivalent full field decode, redaction and non-mutation proof.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master is TBD and asks to clear logs; GPT V2 treats missing Project inputs as permanent BLOCKED despite the standard 0x4D OOB history.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core read is standard; selectors, parser and expected policy are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Resolves the read semantics while keeping Set and activation explicitly out of scope.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike the paired setter, 0x4D is a bounded non-mutating authorization read. Once the schema and scope are pinned, collection and comparison are deterministic, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is justified.
